_comment: Regression guard for the interop record leaking into a chunk with no runtime edge. `entry-a` default-imports the external through a shim tree-shaking drops, which records the interop bundle-wide (see `recorded_external_interop`). `entry-b` only re-exports a *named* binding, so its sole live reference to the external lives in `referenced_symbols_by_entry_point_chunk`, not in any included statement. Its chunk still renders `__toESM` from that bundle-wide record, so `patch_module_dependencies` has to derive the runtime edge from entry exports too — otherwise finalization panics looking up an absent cross-chunk binding.
